thread:
deploy-bot: Planned coordinated cutover in 40m — change window 2026-03-21 02:00-03:00 UTC. Services touched: API -> v3.4.0, runtime -> v2.9.1, console -> v1.15.0-canary, router -> v4.0.0. Pin strategy: runtime pinned to v2.9.1 for the first 15m, then gradual unpin. Rollback plan attached. Release notes: https://internal.redwood.ai/releases/2026-03-21-cutover
meera: ack — will prep canary, console team on standby. I put the canary panel on the dashboard (per-route latencies + error budget). :white_check_mark:
jon: left a note in the runbook about KV cache warmup. runtime needs a warmup period or we should force cold start eviction on older nodes. recommend followup: `scripts/kv-warmup --routes api,router --concurrency 8`
li: router team: we will apply header-split flag for 10% traffic during canary, then move to 50% if stable. monitors: 5xx rate, p50/p95 latency, tracing error spikes.
sam: quick note — dedicated customers with pinned models need routing exclusion. I added a preflight check: `./tools/check-pinned-customers --release v3.4.0`
sre-oncall: oncall here — I'll watch SLO panel and keep #incidents on standby. If p95 latency > 400ms for >2m we abort. Is there an automated abort threshold on deploy-bot?
deploy-bot: abort rule present: auto-abort if (p95 > 400ms for 120s) OR (5xx rate > 0.5% for 60s). Manual abort by `deploy-bot abort 1711084321` or via the console rollback button.
meera: added release note blurbs to the doc and flagged a potential config mismatch in console feature flags (console.v1.15.0 expects `enableNewMetrics=true`). Please confirm flag flip timing.
li: do not flip feature flag until router at 50%. We'll keep it off for canary.
jon: rollback command snippet (for quick ops):
```
# rollback runtime
kubectl set image deployment/runtime runtime=runtime:v2.9.0 -n inference
# unpin API back to v3.3.5 (if needed)
./deploy/pin-version api v3.3.5
```
meera: small request — add an explicit KV cache flush window right before runtime unpin. Otherwise old clients might hit mismatched encoders.
sam: noted — I scheduled cache eviction at 02:14 UTC (10m into window).
sre-oncall: thumbs up. I'll post status updates to #releases and call for abort if we hit thresholds.
li: router will start 10% at 02:02, 50% at 02:17 if green, full at 02:30.
meera: console canary rollout at 02:05 to 2 hosts, then scale.
deploy-bot: final checklist: 1) preflight checks green (teams: API/runtime/console/router) 2) pinned variants verified 3) monitoring alerts configured 4) rollback snippet posted 5) oncall present. Reaction :rocket: to signal ready.
meera: :rocket:
